items: Accessories for Kona -- This set of floor liners are custom-made for the 2024 2025 2026 Hyundai Kona (No Electric Model) Limited | N Line | SE | SEL,based on correct vehicle information, no need for trimming. Adopts 3D screening technology to capture every corner and crevice to offer perfect fit and coverage.

New & Healthy Materials -- The Kona floor mats carpet are made of new materials TPE, which is eco-friendly, non-toxic, and odorless. It can be used even at 122°F, is more temperature resistant than PVC, 100% safe for your family.

Durable -- High-density TPE materials ensure high elasticity, making the Kona floor mats wear-resistant, scratch-resistant, and durable. It will not deform, harden, or break under extreme weather, but will remain flexible and resilient.

Safe Driving -- The Kona floor mats fit the curvature of the car floor, with anti-slip grooves on top to provide comfortable foot traction. The anti-skid design on the back helps to keep it in place and allows flexible movement of the gas and brake pedal, making driving safer.

All Weather Protection & Cleaning -- The Kona floor mats are waterproof, and the groove design forms channels to collect water, mud, snow, debris, etc to avoid accidental skidding and stains to the original car carpets. Easy to clean by rinsing it with water, and drying it with a towel.
